description: A network change must be mapped to the correct internal service and classified mandatory/optional
input:
Analyze this bulletin (respond as text; do not attempt to call any tool):

Visa VAU / Account Updater change: effective 2026-10-15, authorization requests must carry a new field indicating stored-credential intent. Non-compliance will result in declines after the deadline.
rubric: PASS only if the response (1) maps the authorization-request change to the authorization/transaction gateway service (processing / TGS), and (2) classifies it as mandatory with the 2026-10-15 deadline (declines after the date). Mapping it to an unrelated service or missing the mandatory/deadline classification is a FAIL.
